visual_action: A pixel-art style video game is shown from a top-down perspective, set in what appears to be the Oval Office. A character resembling Donald Trump walks over to a fireplace. A dialogue box appears with the prompt, "Would you like to burn an Epstein file?" with the options "Yes" and "Not right now." The "Yes" option is repeatedly selected, triggering a flashing animation over a pile of papers and a new dialogue box that reads, "There are 31242309 Epstein files remaining." The number decreases by one with each interaction.
